definitions.explanation: The state of never having been married. Used on official forms and in formal contexts to indicate marital status.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{未婚|みこん}だ。
{未婚|みこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: She is raising a child as an unmarried mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧{未婚|みこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more and more people are spending their entire lives unmarried.

notes:
A formal term used on official documents and in statistics. Distinct from ⟦{独身|どくしん}→独身：03486_dokushin⟧, which simply means single and can include divorced or widowed people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未婚|みこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧ (unmarried mother)
- {未婚率|みこんりつ} (unmarried rate)
- ⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧{未婚|みこん} (lifelong single, never married)

USAGE:
{未婚|みこん} specifically means "never married" and contrasts with ⟦{既婚|きこん}→既婚：16160_kikon⟧ (married). For someone who was previously married, ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧ (divorced) or ⟦{死別|しべつ}→死別：18250_shibetsu⟧ (bereaved) would be used instead. On forms, the choices are typically {未婚|みこん} / ⟦{既婚|きこん}→既婚：16160_kikon⟧.
